name: AEGIS Governance
description: AEGIS lexical governance preview: audited user-chat admission, delivered tool-call review and optional adaptive model discovery. Coverage depends on host hook dispatch.

activateOnStartup.description: Register governance hooks when the Gateway starts. Set to false to disable governance without removing the plugin. Requires Gateway restart to take effect.

enabled.description: Enable or disable governance evaluation at runtime. Unlike activateOnStartup, this can be toggled without a restart.

threshold.description: Minimum virtue score (0–100) required for execution eligibility. The lowest-scoring virtue is the gate — not the average. Default: 75.

blockOnFail.description: When true, a noncritical failing tool review requests host approval; critical failures block. When false, all failing tool reviews block outright. Does not disable governance. Default: true.

modelPolicy.description: Opt-in native Codex model discovery and selection. Updates only model/runtime configuration; never installs software or handles credentials.

model.description: Model ID to retain in pinned mode.

runtimeCommand.description: auto locates an installed native Codex runtime; otherwise provide an absolute executable path.

bookshelfPath.description: Absolute path to the Bookshelf JSONL file. Append-only. Governance evaluations are written here regardless of verdict. Default: ~/.openclaw/aegis-bookshelf.jsonl
